lessons.claim: If the observation goal is absent from the sketch, that is itself a blocker. trap-2d-5um had an empty stated_goals (abp-rod had 'measure MSD, MSAD'), and without knowing the goal neither T_obs nor the sampling interval nor the success criterion can be fixed. In fact it was only after deciding to look at the PSD that T_obs=2000 tau_k and a sampling interval of tau_k/10 got settled -- do not classify it as a choice; ask the human
